module_summary: Lemmings-style walker wrapper: bumper and ground inputs feed a child phase FSM whose decoded 3-bit action vector is split into walk-left, walk-right and falling outputs.

anchors.name: w_out
anchors.why: Child FSM's decoded action vector; drives all three outputs.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Walking-left state indication, bit of the action vector.

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Walking-right state indication, bit of the action vector.

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: Falling indication, bit of the action vector.

groups.name: walker_fsm
groups.description: lm_core child phase FSM stepped by bump and ground sense inputs.

groups.name: action_outputs
groups.description: Action vector split into individual walk/fall outputs.
